FM 1788 "China Grove" has now had two ETX-tagged low-battery units go dark in two weeks (606, 607). It is worth checking whether these trailers come out of the same batch or yard and whether their battery packs were installed at the same time.
Region tags: 607 is the fifth ETX-tagged unit in the Permian. There is still no confirmation that 605, 608 or 606 were corrected.
No field replies on GPS since 11/6. Your 11/6 report went to Blake and Jimmy (cc Robyn) that evening. Seven units cleared, but nobody has said what was done, so none of the fixes can be confirmed.
